newsitem.title: USA: Buoyed by Intel, Nasdaq hits another record close.
newsitem.headline: Buoyed by Intel, Nasdaq hits another record close.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks pushed to another record close for the second consecutive day, sparked by strong third-quarter profits at bellwhether Intel Corp.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 1.74 points, or 0.14 percent, to close unofficially 1258.10, surpassing yesterday's record high close of 1256.36.
Intel jumped 3-1/2 to 111-1/8 and hit a new year high of 114-1/4 after reporting quarterly earnings, which blew away even the rosiest Wall Street forecasts.
Analysts said although the market was inspired early in the day by Intel, many investors had been locking in profits.
Decliners led advancers 11 to 9 on the Nasdaq and volume was about 588 million shares.

Sun Microsystems shares rose 1-5/8 to 70 in anticipation of the company's earnings. The earnings, which came in at $0.63 a share, 2 cents above First Call estimates, sent Sun shares down four to 66 in the after-hours session, traders said.
Chips and Technologies shares rose 4-7/8 to 19-3/4, after the company posted stronger-than-expected first quarter earnings of $0.42 a share.
